I am 62 years old and this plot is only 0.29 hectares that I am renting, so I will not put manure into land that is not mine. I will buy a small measure of NPK 20-10-10 from the agro-dealer — not a full bag because that costs too much for this small plot — and spread it when the maize is knee-high. I will plant my own maize seed that I kept from last season because improved seed is too expensive for rented soil, and my daughter will help me with planting and weeding over about twenty-eight days of family work because I have no cash to hire anyone. I will not spray chemicals or irrigate because the rains in our South East area come well enough and I must keep my little money for food and that small fertilizer.
